name: FortiVPN
author: Raza Akbari
description: FortiVPN (Fortinet SSL VPN) client for the Omarchy bar. Connect, disconnect, rename and import profiles; openfortivpn does the tunnelling.

barWidget.description: Browse, connect, disconnect, rename, import and remove FortiVPN profiles.

schema.label: Profile filter
schema.description: Show only this profile. Leave empty to list every FortiVPN profile in /etc/openfortivpn.

schema.label: Show profile name in the bar
schema.description: Append the connected profile name next to the bar icon.
